name: Little Lily
source:
You can’t remember how you got here. Amy says you were infected and she’s the only one who can help. The way she watches you makes you doubt it.

[From [url=https://maple0.itch.io/little-lily]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已经记不起自己是怎么来到这里的了。艾米说你受到了感染，而她是唯一能救你的人。可她注视你的眼神，却让你对此心生疑虑。

[摘自[url=https://maple0.itch.io/little-lily]itch.io[/url]]
